transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, to be honest, I'm here because my daughter noticed how distressed I was after a family meal and urged me to talk to someone. I'll sit down to eat and end up putting away way more food than anyone else, more than I ever planned, and it really scares me.
After these episodes of eating a large amount of food, do you feel a strong urge to do something to prevent weight gain, such as vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

It's very hard to admit, but I'll sometimes go into the bathroom, run the tap to hide the sound, and force myself to throw up or take extra laxatives. On other days, I'll try to make up for it by skipping meals entirely or walking laps around the block until my legs ache. I just feel this desperate need to undo what I've done so it doesn't turn into fat.
